name: Book stack
oneLiner: clothbound books drop one after another onto a walnut desk and settle into a stack, each landing with a small bounce that nudges the ones under it, foil titles on their spines; then the top book in the brand colour slides out toward the lens, stands up and turns its foil-stamped cover square to camera as the light runs across the foil
say: when the speaker talks about books they read or the one that mattered ('I read all of these, but one changed everything', 'I wrote it all down in one book'): the stack builds on the list and the top book turns to camera on the one they name
